# Price Volume Trend

*Running total of volume weighted by the percent change.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Price Volume Trend** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/pvt.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Price Volume Trend", shortTitle: "PVT", overlay: false, format: "volume" });
const step = ta.calc([candle.close, candle.volume], (c, v) => { const p = candle.close.at(1); return p ? ((c - p) / p) * v : 0; });
plot(ta.cum(step), { title: "PVT", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
